theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.15%) and Health Care (+1.02%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.05%) and Utilities (-1.22%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.39%, defensives -0.11%, and value/cyclicals -0.23% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.49% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.83%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.59%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 4.18% to 15.81, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 2.90% to $4,308.00, crude oil was little changed at $75.08, and bitcoin gained 0.93% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
